a.content: The RP2040 input voltage high threshold VIH is at least 2 V when IOVDD is 3.3 V.
a.source:
Input Voltage High
@ IOVDD=3.3V
VIH 2 IOVDD + 0.3 V

b.content: The RP2040 input voltage high threshold VIH is at least 1.7 V when IOVDD is 2.5 V.
b.source:
Input Voltage High
@ IOVDD=2.5V
VIH 1.7 IOVDD + 0.3 V

notes: Same part, same symbol, same unit, different values, and no conflict, because each carries its own supply-voltage condition. This is the shape a datasheet table produces most often, and the one a reconciler that drops conditions gets most wrong.
